note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration dictionary with no callable functions, classes, or methods. It defines model architecture, training config, test config, and optimizer settings for a 2-stage Cascade RPN using ResNet-50 Caffe pretrained backbone with FPN on COCO.
summarize_config: summarize the cascade RPN config for a 2-stage proposal network with ResNet-50 Caffe FPN backbone
review_cascade_rpn_head: review the CascadeRPNHead two-stage configuration with dilation and offset adaptation settings
review_train_cfg: review the RegionAssigner and MaxIoUAssigner training config for cascade RPN stages
review_test_cfg: review the NMS test config with 2000 pre-NMS proposals and 0.8 IoU threshold
review_optim_wrapper: review the gradient clipping optimizer wrapper with max norm 35 and L2 norm
